channel.title: Gabon - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gabon, every source cited.

item.title: Gabon votes to lift US embargo on Cuba
item.description: The UN General Assembly passed a resolution calling for the end of the US embargo on Cuba, with Gabon supporting the measure.

item.title: Gabon hosts Congo Basin civil society for COP31 talks
item.description: Over 50 participants from six countries met in Libreville to forge a common stance on climate finance and local rights.

item.title: World Bank reviews Gabon's public finances
item.description: The financial institution presented its 2026 economic outlook to the CESEC on October 28, 2026.

item.title: Gabon navy finds three bodies in Prospector 5 wreck
item.description: Two people remain missing after the Prospector 5 vessel sank, with recovery operations underway.

item.title: Gabon police arrest three over failed explosive bank heist
item.description: Suspects accused of attempting to blow up a vehicle carrying Olam employee payroll funds near Bitam.
